messages:
Ava: I'm taking the night anchor starting 18:00 UTC. Quick pre-handoff check: confirm PagerDuty, AWS console, and Grafana access. Call out any gaps or one-off perms I should expect.
Marcus: Youre set as primary in the infra-oncall PD policy. Grafana shows Viewer + Dash edit. AWS SSO gives you IAM role redwood-Oncall-Admin but not the breakglass role. I can issue a short-lived assume-role for emergencies.
Priya: PD confirms primary = Ava, secondary = Marcus. Make sure mobile notifications are unmuted and PD email alerts are enabled. If you dont see pages, re-login to the mobile app.
Ava: Thanks. Can someone paste the assume-role CLI I should use from the jumpbox if I need elevated creds?
Marcus: From the jumpbox/container run:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-Breakglass --role-session-name oncall-emergency
```
Then export the returned creds and `aws sts get-caller-identity` to validate. Ill DM the MFA flow for console breakglass.
RunbookBot: runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Oncall+Night+Anchor+Playbook (see sections: Immediate PagerDuty Triage, Customer Impact Triage, and Breakglass Procedures)
Ava: Quick questions before I go fully primary: 1) Do I need Grafana Edit to silence alerts? 2) If PD shows no incidents but customers are complaining, what's the short triage?
Marcus: 1) Yes, Edit required to silence or change alert rules. Viewer only reads dashboards. 2) Short triage: check PD incident list, open Grafana /alerts, run `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces` and `kubectl logs -n <ns> <pod>` for suspect services, check inference-serving metrics and the service matrix in the runbook. If errors are customer-facing, tag PD incident with `customer-impact:yes`.
Priya: Customer-impact sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OncallCustomerImpact. Use that for severity decisions; mark incidents with >10% error rate or billing-affecting as customer-impact.
Ava: Marcus, you said I don't have breakglass role. Can that be granted for this shift without a formal ticket?
Marcus: We run a short-lived grant flow. I can request an on-call approval in #sec-ops which auto-creates a temp assume-role for up to 4 hours. Requires manager sign-off in the approval flow. Ill kick it off now.
Marcus: (after a few mins) Done. Temp role created: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-Breakglass-Oncall-Temp. Expires 04:00 UTC. Check SSO roles or try the assume-role CLI.
Ava: I can see and assume the temp role. Verified `aws sts get-caller-identity`. Thanks.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert routed: INC-34567 (high inference-serving latency)  assigned to Ava. https://app.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-34567
Ava: Picking INC-34567. Tailing logs show a spike in 5xx from runtime-shard-2. Marcus can you check the GPU node health and autoscaler?
Marcus: Running `kubectl describe pod model-runtime-shard-2` and checking node memory/GPU. Autoscaler metrics show throttle on provisioning due to quota. Pod restarted 3x in 12m, possible OOM.
Marcus: Filed quota increase with cloud provider and started a manual scale of the node group as mitigation.
Ava: Updating PD incident: tagging `customer-impact:yes`. Noting ~12 hosts with latency >2s. Adding runbook ref: "Inference runtime OOMs" and escalating to product if sustained.
Priya: If scaling takes >15 minutes and errors persist, escalate to oncall-engineering lead and prepare a status update for customers. I can help draft and post status.
Ava: Before I step away briefly at 19:15 UTC: Marcus remains secondary and will revoke temp AWS grant after we close the incident. Priya please monitor PD and escalate if assignment changes.
Marcus: Acknowledged. Ill revoke the temp role when the incident is closed and post a short summary.
Priya: Watching PD. Ill ping product and comms if we need a public status.
Ava: Final handoff checks: anyone who loses Grafana or PD access ping me directly. If I'm out >30m Marcus becomes primary automatically. React with :thumbsup: when done.
Marcus: :thumbsup:
Ava: Heading into triage for INC-34567. Keep me posted on scaling/quota outcome.
